key.name: capture-shortcut
key.summary: Capture shortcut

key.name: output-directory
key.summary: PNG destination; empty uses Pictures/CapIt

key.name: clipboard-content
key.summary: What copy and save puts on the clipboard
key.description: Applies when a capture is both copied and saved; copy only always copies the content. file: a reference to the PNG, GIF or MP4 file, which chat applications, browsers and Files paste as an attachment. content: the image or video data itself, which image editors and some web pages paste directly.

key.name: show-key-hints
key.summary: Show each toolbar button's keyboard shortcut on the button

key.name: timing-log
key.summary: Log how long each capture, export and recording stage takes
key.description: Writes one line per stage to the system journal, for finding what is slow on a given machine. Read them with: journalctl --user -b -g 'CapIt timing'

key.name: element-detection
key.summary: How smart boxes find elements inside windows
key.description: none: whole windows only. visual: panels between the straight dividers of the frozen image, and areas of flat background and what stands out from them, such as cards, fields, tabs and pictures. accessibility: elements the application reports through its accessibility tree.

key.name: show-large-regions
key.summary: Outline a window's large regions while picking
key.description: Draws the large panels that element detection finds in the window under the pointer in coloured dashes, each with a tab showing its size that selects it whole.

key.name: quick-capture
key.summary: Copy and save a screenshot as soon as its region is picked, without annotating
key.description: Clicking a smart box or a large region's tab, or finishing a drag, copies and saves the screenshot at once, as Enter would. The region cannot be adjusted or annotated first. Recordings still start with a click on the area or Enter.

key.name: record-shortcut
key.summary: Recording shortcut
key.description: Opens the capture overlay in the recording mode used last; pressed during a recording, stops it and makes the file.

key.name: recording-mode
key.summary: The recording mode the recording shortcut opens in, set by the last recording started

key.name: recording-output
key.summary: Where a finished GIF or video goes
key.description: both: saved in the output folder and copied to the clipboard. copy: clipboard only. save: output folder only.

key.name: gif-fps
key.summary: GIF frames per second

key.name: recording-show-cursor
key.summary: Draw the pointer into GIF and video recordings

key.name: recording-demo-cursor
key.summary: Highlight the pointer and its clicks in GIF and video recordings

key.name: gif-max-duration
key.summary: Longest GIF recording in seconds; 0 for no limit

key.name: gif-stats-mode
key.summary: How FFmpeg's palettegen builds the GIF palette
key.description: full: one palette from every pixel of the recording. diff: one palette weighted to what changes between frames, which suits a moving part on a still background. single: a new palette for each frame, larger files.

key.name: gif-dither
key.summary: FFmpeg paletteuse dithering

key.name: gif-bayer-scale
key.summary: Bayer pattern scale, used only by bayer dithering; higher shows the pattern less

key.name: video-fps
key.summary: Video frames per second

key.name: video-max-duration
key.summary: Longest video recording in seconds; 0 for no limit

key.name: video-crf
key.summary: x264 constant rate factor; lower is better quality and larger files

key.name: video-preset
key.summary: x264 preset; slower presets make smaller files at the same quality and take longer after stopping
